ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ghostr uses the camera so you can scan a contact's QR code to start an encrypted conversation, scan a safety number to verify a contact's identity, take a photo to send inside a conversation, and set or update your profile picture.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ghostr uses the microphone so you can make end-to-end encrypted voice calls with your contacts and record voice messages to send inside a conversation.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ghostr accesses your photo library when you choose to send an image inside a conversation or select an image as your profile picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Ghostr saves images to your photo library when you tap Save on a photo you received in a conversation, so you can keep it on your device.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Ghostr to use Face ID to unlock the app.
